reply:
SELECT p.name, 1.0 * p.price_minor / m.value
FROM products AS p
JOIN shop_meta AS m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
WHERE p.price_minor > 100 * m.value;

       SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
           (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
            FROM shop_meta
            WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id

GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) DESC, c.id
LIMIT 5;

WITH spending AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.country, c.name,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS total_minor
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY c.id, c.country, c.name
), ranked AS (
    SELECT country, name, total_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY total_minor DESC) AS spending_rank
    FROM spending
)
SELECT country, name,
       total_minor / CAST((SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS REAL)
FROM ranked
WHERE spending_rank = 1
ORDER BY country, name;

       CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(date(o.placed_at)) AS INTEGER)
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id

ORDER BY 3 DESC, o.id ASC;

    SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor)
    FROM order_items AS i
    WHERE i.order_id = o.id
), 0)), 0) / (
    SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
    FROM shop_meta
    WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
)
FROM orders AS o
WHERE o.status = 'pending_payment';

SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(oi.quantity * p.price_minor) -
                      SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor)) /
             NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * p.price_minor), 0), 2)
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category;

FROM products AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items AS oi
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE oi.product_id = p.id
      AND o.status = 'canceled'
);

       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')

GROUP BY o.id
ORDER BY o.id;

WITH spending AS (
    SELECT c.country, c.id, c.name,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS total_minor
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY c.country, c.id, c.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT country, name, total_minor,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY country ORDER BY total_minor DESC, id
           ) AS rn
    FROM spending
)
SELECT country, name,
       total_minor * 1.0 / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       )
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY country;

SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * (SUM(oi.quantity * p.price_minor) -
                    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor)) /
           NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * p.price_minor), 0),
           2
       )
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category;

       / (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)

FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id;

SELECT c.name,
       SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) DESC, c.id
LIMIT 5;

WITH spending AS (
    SELECT c.country, c.id, c.name,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS total_minor
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY c.country, c.id, c.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT country, name, total_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY total_minor DESC) AS spending_rank
    FROM spending
)
SELECT country, name,
       total_minor / (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
                      FROM shop_meta
                      WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM ranked
WHERE spending_rank = 1
ORDER BY country, name;

SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * (SUM(oi.quantity * p.price_minor) - SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor))
           / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * p.price_minor), 0),
           2
       )
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category

SELECT p.name
FROM products AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items AS oi
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE oi.product_id = p.id
      AND o.status = 'canceled'
);
